open_hypotheses.description: A rolling 3-day pairwise return correlation between BTC/ETH/SOL exceeding 0.90 with all three assets co-negative identifies onset of the near-complete lower tail copula regime and should trigger a 50% Strategy A position reduction before the reactive MAX_TOTAL_DD guardrail fires.

open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: L11 establishes baseline BTC/ETH/SOL correlation ≥0.80 in all regimes. 2606.16840 shows that during crashes, the effective copula approaches completeness — standard models underestimate joint-crash prob by ~8×. When rolling 3d pairwise correlation of negative-return days exceeds 0.90 simultaneously across all three pairs, the portfolio has entered the high-density lower tail copula region. A proactive 50% size reduction at this point costs at most 3-4 days of carry; it reduces P(MAX_TOTAL_DD breach) from the tail copula regime materially.

open_hypotheses.description: Compute the tick-size-normalized-by-volatility ratio for BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals (HL) and compare against the small-tick/large-tick threshold from 2607.01550 (CFM) that separates trend-dead from trend-alive traditional futures post-2009 — as a cheap risk diagnostic on Strategy A's structural trend-survival ceiling.
open_hypotheses.data_required: HL perpetual tick sizes (fetchable via HL API, not yet in data/) + existing vol_28d pipeline (already computed for Strategy A). No new market data fetch beyond tick-size metadata.
open_hypotheses.conflict_with_archived: none — risk diagnostic, not a new signal; does not consume Strategy A's 3-modification budget.
open_hypotheses.economic_mechanism: CFM (2607.01550) shows tick-size/vol is the variable separating trend collapse from survival in traditional futures — small tick breaks the self-reinforcing market-impact channel that sustains trend. Crypto perpetuals have effectively continuous tick size relative to price/vol, which by this mechanism should place BTC/ETH/SOL in the 'trend dead' bucket — yet Strategy A shows Sharpe 1.33 OOS. Either crypto trend survives via a different channel (market immaturity, uncrowded retail order flow) with a possibly shorter half-life than assumed, or the mechanism doesn't generalize outside traditional-futures microstructure (informative null either way).
open_hypotheses.success_criterion: Document the computed ratio and a qualitative verdict (falls in 'dead' or 'alive' bucket per the paper's description) in Strategy A's risk notes — diagnostic only, not a backtest gate.
open_hypotheses.priority_note: W28 P2 (<1h, does not compete with Strategy B mainnet checklist for time).
